text:
Residents' Routines:
Felix (40s): Weekdays, home mornings; out 13:40–23:00. Weekends, home except midday errands. Hobbies: movies, houseplants.
Aisha (50s): Works from home. Weekdays, desk 09:00–17:30. Weekends, home except midday errands. Hobbies: friends, meditation, movies.
Ines (30s): Works from home. Weekdays, desk 09:00–17:30. Weekends, home except midday errands. Hobbies: baking, reading, running.

Object Locations & Movement:
Balcony: Watering can (floor), gardening gloves (table).
Bathroom: Felix’s hair dryer, shared laundry basket, Aisha’s razor/skincare, Ines’ skincare (shelf). Aisha/Felix meds (cabinet). Shared soap/toothbrushes (sink). Felix’s razor (sink). Individual towels (rack).
Bedroom 1 (Felix): Pen, plant pot 3 (desk). Book, glasses, tablet, phone (nightstand).
Bedroom 2 (Aisha): Meditation cushion (floor). Headphones, laptop, mug, pen (desk). Book, phone (nightstand).
Bedroom 3 (Ines): Headphones, laptop, mug, pen (desk). Book, glass, phone (nightstand).
Entry: Doormat, Aisha umbrellas (floor). Aisha/Ines jackets, Aisha/Ines scarves (hook). Aisha/Ines keys, Ines sunglasses, Aisha/Ines wallets (table). Ines running shoes, Aisha/Ines shoes (rack).
Kitchen: Cutting board, kettle, knife block, plant pot 2 (counter). Pan, pot, snack bowl (cupboard). Aisha plate (dish rack). Knife, spatula (drawer). Fruit bowl, Felix plate, Ines plate, Ines water bottle (table). Baking tray, mixing bowl, recipe book, shopping bag (pantry). Aisha/Felix/Ines bowls, glasses, Felix mug, Ines plate (sink).
Living: Board game, speaker, vase (bookshelf). Candle, coasters, Aisha/Felix/Ines magazines, tissue box (coffee table). Blanket (couch). Lamp, plant pot 1 (side table). Remote (TV stand).
Storage: Ironing board, vacuum (floor). Toolbox (shelf).

Notes:
- Felix leaves weekdays ~16:00 with backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet, water bottle. These are absent during evening patrols.
- Aisha and Ines are home during weekday evening patrols, working at desks in Bedroom 2 and 3.
- Phones: Aisha/Ines move phones from nightstands to "not in any room" (carried) around 08:00 weekdays. On weekends, phones return to nightstands/dressers by 00:00 and are carried again by 16:00.
- Ines moves headphones, mug, water bottle to desk ~09:24 weekdays, back to sink/table by 16:00.
- Aisha moves laptop, mug, pen to desk ~16:00 weekdays, back to nightstand/cupboard/floor by 00:00.
- Dishes (bowls, mugs, plates, glasses) move from sink/dish rack to cupboard overnight (00:00) and back to sink/table by 08:00-16:00.
- On weekends, all residents are home except during midday errands.
- Ines bakes in the evening (19:53), moving recipe book, pan, pot, knife, spatula to counter.
- Sunday 12:26: Aisha/Ines put away dishes (glasses, plates, bowls, knife, pan, pot, spatula, recipe book) to cupboard/drawer/pantry.
